protocol.prefix_handoff: Permanent before-action handoff to same expert on first independently sampled bad contact or 32-interval cap; no reactivation
protocol.expert: Exactly one unchanged teacher.act before every interval, including prefix; no teacher reset at handoff
protocol.labels: expert_action is separate from recorded actual action; post-prefix equality exact; old training loader rejects profile
protocol.counter: 45 back queries (40+5), no turn/forward phase; final query may complete and restart, replacing old emitted action
protocol.coverage: each first cycle: observed contact/sign at start, 45 emitted back targets without replacement, actual post-prefix reverse, later observed clearance
protocol.contact: independent prior contact-cache sensor plus ten actual pre-control caches/end; intentional robot-obstacle1 allowed, no continuous collision claim
protocol.collection_boundary: Earliest first 45-returned-label cycle without replacement plus later fully admitted recorded interval with cached and stage-zero intended-contact clearance; publish before stopping; no hardcoded tick
protocol.outcomes: coverage_complete is collection-only, not natural termination; otherwise natural outcome or 120 cap; collect both valid sources before scoring; infrastructure/invariant/storage stops remaining not_started
protocol.student: unchanged 388 RGB/contact/bearing features; privileged teacher/private history not student inputs
protocol.scope: two mirrored first-cycle development sources; event boundary deliberately censors later driving, does not cure or reclassify v1/v2 failures; no training, held-out reads, learned/general/task/body/physical qualification
